environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed in production account governed by AWS Organizations SCP. The RDS PostgreSQL instance uses IAM database authentication with a narrowly-scoped database role. The DB_USER is 'svc_readonly_cleanup' which was provisioned via Terraform with the following PostgreSQL role definition: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO svc_readonly_cleanup; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO svc_readonly_cleanup; No additional privileges granted. The pg_hba.conf enforces 'hostssl' only connections. Note: the Lambda function's IAM role has rds-db:connect permission scoped to this specific DB user ARN only. CloudWatch Logs Insights query monitors for any ERROR responses from the function. The Step Functions state machine has a ResultSelector that filters output fields.

config.db_role_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO svc_readonly_cleanup
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights ERROR filter with SNS alarm
